title: Prediction-Market Session Playbook
description: The frozen contract for one session of 15-minute prediction-market windows. Written by the desk at /pm-open and evaluated mechanically by bin/pm on every window. It is the analogue of the options watchlist: the rules are decided once, calmly, and the loop applies them. It cannot be relaxed intraday except by an appended revision with a reason.

revisions.description: Append-only. Any intraday change lands here with a reason; the original value is never overwritten.

venue.description: Where the client executes. Robinhood event contracts route to Kalshi.

gate_at_open.description: The calibration gate as it stood when the playbook was written. Recorded so the session's sizing can be audited against what the desk knew.

assets.description: Assets in play this session. Capped: each one is a ticket every 15 minutes and the client's attention does not scale. Empty is a legitimate session.

verified.description: False until the client has confirmed the fee schedule in the app. Every edge number is only as good as this.

rules.description: Mechanical entry rules. bin/pm applies these; the desk does not reinterpret them window by window.

min_edge_per_contract.description: Model probability minus cost (ask + fee) must clear this, in dollars per $1 contract.

max_model_confidence.description: Above this the apparent edge is tail model error, not opportunity. Pass.

blackouts.description: Windows the desk will not trade: scheduled prints, known events, anything that breaks the zero-drift assumption.

max_stake_per_window.description: On a binary the stake IS the max loss.

max_session_loss.description: Realized losses plus open stake may not exceed this. The desk halts, it does not chase.

paper_stake.description: Notional used to size paper decisions so their P/L is comparable across windows.

gate.description: Thresholds for the calibration gate. Real size is earned by measured performance, not granted by conviction.
